title: Daily digest: It’s a win! Jamia approves students’ uni | Three Agencies Conduct Simultaneous Sear | 36,351 police personnel deployed for ULB | Naidu Orders Faster Restoration In Cyclo
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: It’s a win! Jamia approves students’ union polls, May 15 deadline.
Three Agencies Conduct Simultaneous Searches at NIMS.
36,351 police personnel deployed for ULB polls in Andhra Pradesh.
Naidu Orders Faster Restoration In Cyclone-Hit Areas.
bullets_ur: Yeh aik jeet hai! Jamia ne students' union polls ki manzoori de di, 15 May ki deadline.
Teen agenciyon ne NIMS mein aik sath talashi ki karrawai ki
Andhra Pradesh mein ULB intikhabat ke liye 36,351 police ahlkar tainaat kar diye gaye.
